tooling_note: Multi-agent tools are discoverable in this session, but their policy allows spawning only when the user explicitly asks for delegation. This room is therefore simulated as named reviewers following the carousel-agent-room contract.

agents.name: Storyline Architect
agents.verdict: Protect the emotional machine: the tiny bid is really asking, 'Are you with me in this moment?'

agents.name: Contrarian Critic
agents.verdict: Reject any route that leads with 86/33 as infographic copy. The stat should sharpen the caption or frame, not carry the scene.

agents.name: Retention Analyst
agents.verdict: The share trigger is not the research; it is the recognition of 'dekh na' as a relationship moment.

agents.name: Visual Director
agents.verdict: The winning route must show a hand pausing, a body turning, an eye-line following, and a second bid returning.

agents.name: Copy Chief
agents.verdict: Hold public copy until concept approval. Public wording should stay name-free and scene-native.

agents.name: Algorithm / Brand Strategist
agents.verdict: A desi micro-phrase gives the idea tag/send behavior; therapy terms should move to caption only if needed.

agents.name: World-Class Taste Judge
agents.verdict: The route passes only if it becomes a physical two-way ritual, not a generic 'good partner pays attention' post.

agents.name: Harsh Final Selector
agents.verdict: Select 'The Dekh Na Test' after repair. It is the clearest, most ownable way to turn Gottman into A Story of Two behavior.
